items.title: Anthropic To Seek $1.4 Trillion Valuation in Blockbuster IPO
items.brief: Anthropic’s debut on public markets will be unlike any that’s come before it, in ways that amount to either a once-in-a-generation opportunity — or a massive financial gamble, depending on whom you ask.

items.title: California voters reject one-time wealth tax on billionaires
items.brief: Voters in California have rejected a measure to impose a one-time 5% wealth tax on residents with a net worth of over $1 billion.

items.title: US evacuates aircraft from British military base after threat from Iran, WSJ reports
items.brief: The United States has evacuated American military aircraft from a military base in England on Monday following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal , which cited sources familiar with the matter.

items.title: Suspect in custody as FBI investigates a possible killing aboard a cruise ship out of Texas
